newsitem.title: UK: IBCA assigns ratings to Spain's Bankoa.
newsitem.headline: IBCA assigns ratings to Spain's Bankoa.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency said on Tuesday it had assigned a short-term rating of A3 and a long-term rating of BBB to Bankoa, a small, regional bank based in the Basque country of northern Spain.
IBCA has also assigned an individual rating of C and a legal rating of 5.
IBCA said Bankoa was founded as an industrial bank, and has diversified operations to include lending to individuals, which now accounts for around 60 percent of its loan portfolio.

"However, lending represents a smaller than average proportion (around 30 percent) of total assets, with Bankoa holding a greater than average proportion in government securities and in interbank placements," IBCA said.
The agency said Bankoa experienced deteriorating asset quality in the recent recession, but tighter loan concessions and monitoring systems have improve this to an above average position.
"The bank maintains good liquidity and strong capital adequacy, the latter aided in no small way by its holdings of government securities and an increasing proportion of mortgage loans," IBCA said.
